question: Where can I find a gallery within 70 kilometers, oriented toward the north of Hairpin Turn, Clarksburg, MA?
sql: SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_state, P.addr_city FROM pois AS P CROSS JOIN ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hairpin Turn%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Clarksburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ) AS HairpinTurn WHERE P.tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, HairpinTurn.geometry::geography, 70000) AND ( degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(HairpinTurn.geometry), ST_Centroid(P.geometry))) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(HairpinTurn.geometry), ST_Centroid(P.geometry))) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 );
